excerpt: Build a complete Sharjah apartment purchase budget, including registration, brokerage, financing, initial work and a separate reserve.
introduction:
The total cost of buying an apartment in Sharjah includes more than the advertised price. Registration and other charges depend on the buyer, property, transaction and agreement, so obtain an itemised current quote from the relevant authority and providers. Include finance, initial work and ongoing building costs in the decision.

The example in this guide uses sample amounts to demonstrate a budget. The calculation provides a practical worksheet for the apartment and purchase terms you choose.
takeaways: Confirm the buyer's ownership right and the current property-specific registration quote before paying.
Add brokerage, finance, inspection and initial work to the agreed price, and keep a separate reserve.
Compare ongoing service charges and mortgage payments as well as the initial cash required.

sections.heading: Which costs should you identify?
sections.body:
Ask for the agreed unit price, registration and title charges, developer or management clearance, brokerage, any tax on services and the party responsible for each item. For a financed purchase, add valuation, bank fees, insurance and the timing of the loan. For a ready apartment, obtain estimates for inspection and immediate work.

The Sharjah Executive Council's [property sale service listing](https://ec.shj.ae/en/government-service-details?serviceId=7804877f29e1d98d856134f4180a0517ef859c39c3ca891bc3a13e3773b7316bf5fcd08d2966872ceec3e0acf29842ff) describes a title transfer service. Ask Sharjah's registration department for the current process and itemised fee quote for your exact unit and nationality.

Promotional terms for a particular event or project are not a universal schedule. Check whether an incentive applies to your unit and whether its conditions are recorded in the contract.

sections.heading: Work through a sample budget
sections.body:
Suppose an apartment costs AED 800,000, registration and related charges are assumed at AED 40,000, brokerage at AED 16,000, finance costs at AED 9,000 and immediate repairs at AED 10,000. The total is AED 875,000 before a separate contingency reserve and other ongoing expenses.

These example amounts show how the different purchase costs contribute to the total budget. The chart separates the example components. An actual transaction may have different charges, allocation, tax, insurance and payment timing.

A mortgage reduces the price paid in cash at transfer but creates repayments and a balance outstanding. Prepare a separate cash-flow schedule using the bank's actual offer; the total property cost is not the same as the initial down payment.

sections.heading: Confirm the ownership right and registration
sections.body:
[WAM's report of Sharjah's 2022 ownership decision](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/hszrfs32-sharjah-executive-council-issues-decision-allowing) describes ownership by all nationalities in real estate development areas and projects. Confirm eligibility for the exact apartment and buyer with the relevant authority. Ask the registration department to confirm the right for your nationality and exact unit.

Review the title or initial registration, seller authority, any mortgage or lease and required developer clearance. For an off-plan purchase, confirm the registered project, payment recipient, contract and instalments. The [Sharjah ownership eligibility guide](/journal/how-to-check-foreign-ownership-eligibility-in-sharjah) explains the questions to ask.

Verify payment instructions through independently confirmed contacts and keep the official registration outcome and receipts. A reservation receipt alone is not a title deed.

sections.heading: Plan cash and finance timing
sections.body:
Record each deposit, instalment, bank disbursement and fee due date on a calendar. Confirm whether a booking amount is credited towards the price and when it may be refunded. Do not count the same payment twice.

Ask the lender for the loan amount, valuation, interest or profit rate, fees, insurance and repayment schedule. Approval and financing depend on the applicant and property. Test a smaller loan or delayed approval, and maintain cash for the difference.

For off-plan, include the full handover and any later balance. A low first instalment does not make the remaining obligation disappear. Allow for continued rent or other housing costs until the home is ready.

sections.heading: Budget for ownership after purchase
sections.body:
Request the current unit service-charge statement, payment schedule, building management contact and any arrears or major work information. Ask what utilities and cooling are billed separately. Include insurance, maintenance and a reserve for repairs inside the apartment.

For a rental investment, allow for vacancy and the owner's management costs. Compare recent signed leases for similar units rather than treating an advertised yield as a guarantee. For a family home, include school transport and commuting in the household budget.

The [Sharjah family area guide](/journal/best-areas-to-buy-property-in-sharjah-for-families) helps compare locations, but costs and facilities vary by building and unit.

sections.heading: Compare ready and off-plan quotations
sections.body:
A ready apartment may need a larger payment at transfer and immediate repair work. An off-plan unit may spread the price across several dates, but the later payments remain due under the agreement. Request the full schedule and an itemised quote for both; a smaller booking payment is not the total purchase cost.

Ask which authority and developer charges are payable at reservation, registration and handover. If an incentive covers a fee, confirm the conditions and whether it reduces the amount you would otherwise pay. Do not assume that a promotional payment plan includes every transaction charge.

sections.heading: Keep a separate contingency
sections.body:
A reserve is money set aside for future expenses and kept separate from official fees. Consider a repair, a delayed handover or a smaller mortgage approval and check whether the purchase remains affordable. If you must pay rent during construction, include that on the cash calendar.

Update the budget when a written quotation or lender valuation changes. A subtotal that excludes an unknown charge should be clearly marked as incomplete until the amount and responsible party are confirmed.

sections.heading: Request a property-specific quote
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Sharjah project collection](/projects?emirate=Sharjah) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your nationality, budget and intended use. Ask which units are currently available and request the exact plan, price and written cost breakdown.

Confirm eligibility and current authority charges before making a payment.
